kyoto_shichimiya_honpo.gf_detail: Ask. Shichimi and sansho blends are spices (shop site); the pork buns sold at the shop are wheat (2024–26 reviews). No allergen information.
kyoto_shichimiya_honpo.vegan_detail: Ask. The spice blends are plant-based by nature but no vegan claim is sourced; the dashi packs and the chicken-oil condiment are not vegan (shop site), and the buns contain pork.
kyoto_shichimiya_honpo.hours_raw: Takeaway only — a spice shop, no seating (Tabelog). 9:30–17:30, varying with the season; open all year (Tabelog). Tastings before you buy (2017–21 reviews). Pork buns with the house shichimi, ¥500, sold from the shop (May 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Online shop and stockists (shop site). Founded in the Meireki era (shichimiya.co.jp); the recipe is described as passed down to a single heir (「一子相伝の味」). At the meeting of Sannenzaka and Gojozaka on the way to Kiyomizu-dera (shop site).
kyoto_shichimiya_honpo.notes: [Shichimi · takeaway · Kiyomizu] A spice shop at the fork of Sannenzaka and Gojozaka that has sold its own shichimi togarashi since the Meireki era — "over three hundred years", the shop says: blends heavy on sansho, chilli powders, dashi packs, and a shichimi pork bun to eat as you walk. Takeaway only. Founded in the Meireki era (shichimiya.co.jp); recipe passed to a single heir, per the shop site.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop site: 「明暦年間の創業以来」 — founded in the Meireki era, "over three hundred years" (三百有余年), the recipe kept as 「一子相伝の味」, passed down to a single heir.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the shop site: preserving a flavour passed to a single heir.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 buyer grew up with this shop’s shichimi — the one always kept at home by the reviewer’s mother — and loves it on udon.
A May 2026 visitor ate the ¥500 pork bun with a shake of the house shichimi after visiting Kiyomizu-dera.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 明暦年間の創業以来、三百有余年、一子相伝の味、産寧坂・五条坂の交わる場所、七味・一味・山椒、だしパック、鶏油の調味料、カルビーと作ったポテトのお菓子、オンラインショップ。食べログ: その他、東山区清水2-221、9:30〜17:30 (季節により変更)、年中無休、持ち帰りのみ、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2025年9月・2026年5月、英語): 山椒の香りの七味、うどんに、350年以上の老舗、七味をかけて食べる肉まん500円。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway only; ask to taste blends before buying.

existence.note: Shop site; Tabelog reviews dated September 2025 and May 2026.

kyoto_teppachi_chicken.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: karaage, croquettes, fried rice, soy-seasoned stir-fries (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_teppachi_chicken.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken izakaya — karaage, chicken stir-fries, katsuo tataki (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_teppachi_chicken.hours_raw: Dinner Mon–Wed, Fri, Sat 18:00–22:00; holidays and the day before 18:00–22:30; closed Thursday and Sunday; lunch from 11:30 until sold out (Tabelog). Lunch is one daily set, ¥800–850 with a free large rice, plus bento to take away from ¥500 (November 2025, January 2026); it fills quickly (November 2026). Dinner courses with all-you-can-drink, ¥4,500 (January 2026). Reservations until the day before (Tabelog). Dogs welcome inside, including the three private rooms upstairs (January 2024, January and November 2026). No cards or e-money; PayPay (Tabelog). 25 seats: a five-seat counter downstairs, private rooms upstairs (Tabelog; 2024 review). Down a narrow alley just east of Kawaramachi-Marutamachi (2024 review, November 2025).
kyoto_teppachi_chicken.notes: [Karaage izakaya · Kawaramachi-Marutamachi] A small alley izakaya near Kawaramachi-Marutamachi known for juicy karaage: an ¥800-odd daily lunch set with free large rice and cheap bento, and ¥4,500 all-you-can-drink courses at night. Dogs are welcome inside, even in the private rooms upstairs. Closed Thursday and Sunday; PayPay or cash.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: an izakaya opened 9 January 2023 near Kawaramachi-Marutamachi, serving chicken dishes, lunch sets and bento.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 family chose it for a daughter’s twentieth-birthday dinner because the dog could come inside, and had the ¥4,500 course in a private room upstairs.
A November 2025 lunch diner had the ¥800 set of karaage and stir-fried chicken with eggplant, with a free large rice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・鶏料理、中京区末丸町278-6、夜は月火水金土18:00〜22:00、祝日と祝日の前日18:00〜22:30、木・日曜休み、昼は11:30から売り切れまで、予約は前日まで、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay 可、25席、2023年1月9日オープン。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年11月、英語): 唐揚げが名物、昼は日替わり定食800〜850円 (ご飯大盛り無料)、弁当500円から、夜は飲み放題付きのコース4,500円、韓国風のおにぎり、犬も店内可、2階に完全個室3室、河原町丸太町の東の路地。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by the day before for dinner; bring your dog if you like. Cash or PayPay only. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_geijutsu_kissa_itoyufu.gf_detail: Ask. The matcha tiramisu is described as gluten-free (March 2026); the baked cheesecake and seasonal sweets are not. No cross-contact information.
kyoto_geijutsu_kissa_itoyufu.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: the matcha tiramisu is described as vegan (March 2026); ask about plant milk for lattes. The baked cheesecake is not vegan.
kyoto_geijutsu_kissa_itoyufu.hours_raw: Daily except Tuesday 7:30–18:00 (Tabelog). 「各自ワンドリンクオーダー必須キャッシュレスオンリー（現金払い不可）」 — one drink per person, and cashless only, no cash (Tabelog). A counter and benches beside a small gallery with changing exhibitions (March and April 2026). Closed 8–30 June 2026 for renovation (May 2026). In a renovated wooden townhouse that was a tobacco shop, near Higashi Honganji and Shoseien, about ten minutes from Kyoto Station; opened 2 February 2026 (Tabelog; February and April 2026).
kyoto_geijutsu_kissa_itoyufu.notes: [Gallery café · near Higashi Honganji] A quiet gallery café opened in 2026 by the Kyoto pottery brand QUTOTEN. in an old tobacco shop near Higashi Honganji: matcha lattes and coffee in its own tea ware, a vegan, gluten-free matcha tiramisu, baked cheesecake and seasonal sweets, with art and bonsai on show. Cashless only; one drink each; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a gallery café produced by the Kyoto pottery brand QUTOTEN., opened 2 February 2026 in a renovated wooden former tobacco shop; the name refers to spider threads shimmering in the air (February 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Matcha latte in house tea ware; matcha tiramisu.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor watched the unsweetened matcha latte made to order and noted the small matcha tiramisu is vegan and gluten-free.
A March 2026 guest came for an exhibition of bonsai-like works and had a matcha latte in a QUTOTEN. collaboration cup.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、下京区天神町396-4、火曜以外7:30〜18:00、各自ワンドリンクオーダー必須、キャッシュレスのみ (現金不可)、2026年2月2日オープン。口コミ (2026年2月〜9月、英語): 京都の陶磁器ブランド QUTOTEN. のギャラリーカフェ、元たばこ屋の木造の町家を改装、ギャラリーの展示が変わる、抹茶ティラミス800円 (ヴィーガン・グルテンフリー)、ベイクドチーズケーキ850円、季節の甘味1,000円、季節のドリンク1,000円、カフェラテ700円、無糖の抹茶ラテ、Komyo tea 500円、ブレンド、タンザニアの浅煎り、カウンターとベンチ、東本願寺・渉成園の近く、京都駅から徒歩約10分、2026年6月8日〜30日は改装で休み。

cultural_comfort.note: Bring a card or app — no cash. One drink each. Seats are a counter and benches, so it can be close. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Shop site; Tabelog reviews dated through September 2026.
